description: Polyrhythmic clock generator running a base clock and five more clocks at whole-number fractions of it, each with a gate and a tempo CV output

params.text: Sets the base tempo, 30 to 480 beats per minute, with 120 at noon
Sets how many base beats that clock's beat count is spread over, 1 to 32
Sets how many beats that clock fits into the base-beat count set by its per M base knob, 1 to 32
Sets the fraction of each of that clock's cycles for which its gate is high, a square gate at 0.5
Returns every clock to the start of its cycle while it is pressed
Sets how many base beats pass between automatic resets, 0 to 64, with no automatic reset at 0

inputs.text: A trigger here switches between running and stopped
A trigger here returns every clock to the start of its cycle
Sets the base tempo in place of the BPM knob, 0V giving 120 beats per minute and a volt for each doubling

outputs.text: A 10V gate at the base tempo, high for half of each beat
A 10V gate at the rate of that clock, high for the fraction of each cycle set by its p/w knob
The base tempo as a voltage, 0V at 120 beats per minute and a volt for each doubling
That clock's tempo as a voltage, 0V at 120 beats per minute and a volt for each doubling
A 10V trigger 96 samples long each time running starts or stops
A 10V trigger 96 samples long each time a reset happens

notes: every clock starts as soon as the module is added, because run comes up on.
